title: Sum of Two Numbers (function)
statement:
Implement solve(a, b) that returns the sum of the two integers a and b.

Input: two integers a and b.
Output: their sum.

python.driver:
{{SOLUTION}}
import sys
d = sys.stdin.read().split()
print(solve(int(d[0]), int(d[1])))

solutions.python:
def solve(a, b):
    return a + b
solutions.cpp: long solve(long a, long b){ return a + b; }
solutions.java: static long solve(long a, long b){ return a + b; }

title: Sum of an Array (function)
statement:
Implement solve(arr) that returns the sum of all integers in the array arr.

Input: line 1 has N, line 2 has N integers.
Output: their sum.

python.driver:
{{SOLUTION}}
import sys
d = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(d[0])
arr = list(map(int, d[1:1+n]))
print(solve(arr))

solutions.cpp: long solve(vector<long>& arr){ long s=0; for(auto x:arr) s+=x; return s; }
solutions.java: static long solve(int[] arr){ long s=0; for(int x:arr) s+=x; return s; }

title: Reverse a String (function)
statement:
Implement solve(s) that returns the string s reversed.

Input: a single word.
Output: the reversed word.

solutions.cpp: string solve(string s){ reverse(s.begin(), s.end()); return s; }
solutions.java: static String solve(String s){ return new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString(); }

title: Maximum in Array (function)
statement:
Implement solve(arr) that returns the largest integer in the array arr.

Input: line 1 has N, line 2 has N integers.
Output: the maximum.

python.driver:
{{SOLUTION}}
import sys
d = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(d[0])
arr = list(map(int, d[1:1+n]))
print(solve(arr))

solutions.java: static long solve(int[] arr){ long m=arr[0]; for(int x:arr) m=Math.max(m,x); return m; }
